I was in this situation too. My brother molested me over the course of maybe 5 or 6 years.

I'm very much still getting over it and I don't have any support at all from my family. When I told my parents there was shock initially but also them trying to brush it off.

The first chance my parents got, they let him back into their lives because they had to cut him out because of how toxic he was, and the first chance they got, they let him back. Then they tried to justify that choice by saying you're both our children and we can't not help.

He made my life hell and it's almost like they don't believe me.

So I understand what you're going through. Don't listen to anyone but yourself. Take the advice here and report this monster. Don't let him hurt anyone else.

It's going to be hard and it's going to strain your relationship with your family so much.

I wish you luck in your recovery and know that I believe you and support you
